service.description: The organization as a tree, a level at a time, as of asOfDate (now when empty; a date alone is the end of that day). Without parentPartyId, the top: the employers the caller reads whose parent they do not read; with it, its children on the date (departments, teams, and internal organizations the caller reads, shown as legal organizations); with term, every department and team under the employers whose name or id matches, ignoring case. Each row: name, kind (organization, department or team), parent and since when, employer, lead, people (an organization's current employees, a unit's current members), the children shown, whether the caller may change it and its revision. organizationPartyId narrows the employers (ORGANIZATION_DENIED outside the scope); a parent outside it is refused as a missing one (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE). Refuses a caller who reads no employer (PERMISSION_DENIED).

parameter.name: units
parameter.description: partyId, organizationName, unitKind, kindText, parentPartyId, parentName, sinceText, employerPartyId, employerName, headPartyId, headName, peopleCount, childCount, canEdit, revision

service.description: One internal organization, department or team the caller reads, as of asOfDate: its row as find#Units gives it, its parents (every dated rollup, newest first, with state and reason) and, for a department or team, its memberships (every dated PrtMember row: person, member or lead, from, through, state and revision); the unit's membersEditable (P6: a team's for an HR editor; a department's members are its employees' assignments'). Refuses one outside the scope as a missing one (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE) and a caller who reads no employer (PERMISSION_DENIED).

A new department or team (unitKind) under a parent from fromDate (now when empty): an Organization with the OrgDepartment or OrgTeam role, owned by its employer, and a dated PrtOrgRollup to the parent; or an existing unit's new name, a move to another parent from fromDate (the rollup in effect ends then, a new one starts, both kept) and a new lead (headPartyId, store#Membership's rules). changeReason is the ended row's audit and the new row's comment. Needs PEOPLE_HR_VIEW and PEOPLE_HR_EDIT (PERMISSION_DENIED). Refuses: KIND_INVALID, NAME_REQUIRED, PARENT_REQUIRED; a parent or unit outside the scope (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE); an internal organization, which is Admin's, or a team with no parent unit, which another application keeps and People reads only (NOT_A_UNIT; People follow-up 3 review); a department under a team (PARENT_KIND); a move to another legal employer (EMPLOYER_CHANGE), under itself or a unit below it (PARENT_CYCLE), on a date when the unit has no parent (DATE_STALE) or while a later move is set (PARENT_SCHEDULED); an expectedRevision other than the unit's (REVISION_CHANGED). With close, the unit is closed from thruDate (no earlier than now): refused while a unit is under it (UNIT_HAS_CHILDREN), a position is in the department (UNIT_HAS_POSITIONS) or a membership starts later (MEMBERSHIP_SCHEDULED); a department's employees move to reassignPartyId, another department of the employer (REASSIGNMENT_REQUIRED, REASSIGNMENT_INVALID), each a reorganization of their employment's assignment from the date (P6); its remaining memberships and its rollup end on the date.

parameter.name: partyId

parameter.name: unitKind
parameter.description: department or team, for a new unit

parameter.name: expectedRevision
parameter.description: The unit's revision as find#Units or get#Unit read it, for a change

parameter.name: reassignPartyId
parameter.description: The department a closed department's employees move to

service.description: A person joins a team (unitPartyId) as a member (from role Assignee) or its lead (Manager) from fromDate (now when empty): a dated PrtMember row, never an employment; a member in the other role changes role from the date, and a new lead's predecessor stays on as a member. A department's members are its employees' assignments' (P6: DEPARTMENT_MEMBERSHIP; its lead is changed through store#Unit). With partyRelationshipId, that membership ends on thruDate (now when empty). changeReason is the ended row's audit and the new row's comment. Needs PEOPLE_HR_VIEW and PEOPLE_HR_EDIT (PERMISSION_DENIED) and a unit in the scope (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE; NOT_A_UNIT for an internal organization or a team with no parent unit, another application's). Refuses: a person not employed by the unit's employer on the date, for a team neither employed by nor a current agent of it (a contractor; People follow-up 3) (NOT_EMPLOYED), a membership in the same role (ALREADY_MEMBER) or one starting later (MEMBERSHIP_SCHEDULED), ROLE_INVALID, PERSON_REQUIRED, a department (DEPARTMENT_MEMBERSHIP); for an end, a membership not of the unit (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), one already ended (MEMBERSHIP_ENDED), a date before it starts (DATE_STALE) and an expectedRevision other than the row's (REVISION_CHANGED).

An agent's (a contractor's) agency with an employer ended on thruDate (the PartyRelationship EECA AgentEndsMemberships, on a PrtAgent row's thruDate set or moved earlier, whoever writes it): their memberships and leads of the employer's teams end on that date, as a separation ends an employee's, unless they still work for the employer then (an employment or another agency); a membership starting later ends on its own start. Failure tolerant per membership (logged) and never refuses (People follow-up 3 review, the user's call of Nov 12, 2026). No permission: the record's change is the trigger.

The reporting lines as a tree, a level at a time, as of asOfDate (now when empty): a node per current employment by an employer the caller reads (organizationPartyId narrows them; ORGANIZATION_DENIED outside the scope), placed under the manager of its line at that employer (a PrtManager from a manager the employer employs too). Without a manager, the top: the employments with no manager at their employer (noManager), listed rather than lost; with managerPartyId, that manager's reports; with parentNodeId (a node's id, organizationPartyId/partyId), that node's reports; with partyId, that person's own nodes (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE when the employers do not employ them); with term, the people whose name or id matches, ignoring case. Each node is the directory's public work identity (name, preferred name, employer, job title, work email, phone and location), the manager and the count of direct reports; for an HR editor also lineRevision (change#Manager's expectedRevision) and lineSinceText. Paged, or with pageNoLimit up to 2000. Refuses a caller who reads no employer (PERMISSION_DENIED).

parameter.name: nodes
parameter.description: nodeId, parentNodeId, partyId, personName, preferredName, organizationPartyId, organizationName, jobTitle, managerPartyId, managerName, noManager, workEmail, workPhone, workLocation, reportCount; for an HR editor lineRevision and lineSinceText

service.description: A dated reporting change at an employer: the person's line there ends on fromDate (now when empty) and, with managerPartyId, a new one starts (PrtManager from the manager, role Manager, to the person, role Employee); without it, the person has no manager there from the date. changeReason is the ended line's audit and the new line's comment. organizationPartyId is the employer of the line, needed when two employers the caller reads employ the person on the date. For an employment with an assignment (P6) the manager is the assignment's: the change is a manager change of the employment from the date (PeopleServices' Employment.js; the line follows), and expectedRevision is the employment's (get#ReportingTree's lineRevision). Needs PEOPLE_HR_VIEW and PEOPLE_HR_EDIT (PERMISSION_DENIED). Refuses: a person outside the scope (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE) or not employed there on the date (NOT_EMPLOYED); ORGANIZATION_REQUIRED, PERSON_REQUIRED; SELF_REPORTING; a manager the employer does not employ on the date (MANAGER_NOT_EMPLOYED); a manager below the person at that employer (REPORTING_CYCLE); the manager they have (MANAGER_UNCHANGED); a line starting later (MANAGER_SCHEDULED); a line ended or started that would also be a line at an employer the caller does not read, the manager and the person both employed there (LINE_SHARED); an expectedRevision other than the line in effect (REVISION_CHANGED; empty for no line).

parameter.name: expectedRevision
parameter.description: get#ReportingTree's lineRevision; empty when the person has no manager there
